Toast

Toasts are lightweight notifications that surface short, non-blocking messages near the edge of the screen.

Basic Toast

A minimal toast with title and supporting text.

File uploaded
report-q3.pdf has been uploaded.
HTML
<div class="zak-toast">
    <div style="flex:1;">
        <div class="zak-toast-title">File uploaded</div>
        <div class="zak-toast-text">report-q3.pdf has been uploaded.</div>
    </div>
    <button class="zak-toast-close" aria-label="Close toast">&times;</button>
</div>

Toast Positions

Toast containers place toasts in six fixed corners and centers using position modifiers.

Top left
at the top-left of the viewport.
Top center
at the top-center of the viewport.
Top right
at the top-right of the viewport.
Bottom right
at the bottom-right of the viewport.
Bottom left
at the bottom-left of the viewport.
Bottom center
at the bottom-center of the viewport.
HTML
<div class="zak-toast-container zak-toast-container-top-start">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast-container zak-toast-container-top-center">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast-container zak-toast-container-top-end">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast-container zak-toast-container-bottom-start">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast-container zak-toast-container-bottom-center">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast-container zak-toast-container-bottom-end">...</div>

Toast Variants

Variants tint the icon badge to communicate success, error, warning, or info.

Saved
Changes saved successfully.
Error
Something went wrong.
Warning
Storage space running low.
Info
A new version is available.
HTML
<div class="zak-toast zak-toast-success">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast zak-toast-danger">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast zak-toast-warning">...</div>
<div class="zak-toast zak-toast-info">...</div>

Toast with Action

Include a call to action such as "Undo" inside the toast.

Item deleted
Post was moved to trash.
HTML
<div class="zak-toast zak-toast-info">
    <span class="zak-toast-icon">...</svg></span>
    <div style="flex:1;">
        <div class="zak-toast-title">Item deleted</div>
        <div class="zak-toast-text">Post was moved to trash.</div>
    </div>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-link zak-btn-sm">Undo</button>
</div>

Auto-Dismiss Toast

Click the button to show a toast that disappears after 3 seconds.

Auto-dismiss is handled with setTimeout. See the JavaScript section.
HTML
function showAutoToast(message) {
    var toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = 'zak-toast zak-toast-success';
    toast.innerHTML = '<div style="flex:1;"><div class="zak-toast-title">' + message +
        '</div><div class="zak-toast-text">This toast auto-dismisses.</div></div>';
    container.appendChild(toast);
    setTimeout(function() {
        toast.remove();
    }, 3000);
}

Interactive Demo

Use the buttons to trigger toasts in a fixed container.

JavaScript

A small helper to create, append, and remove toasts.

HTML
var zakToast = (function() {
    var container = document.getElementById('toast-demo-container');

    var icons = {
        success: '<svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>',
        danger: '<svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M15 9l-6 6M9 9l6 6"/></svg>',
        warning: '<svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/><path d="M12 9v4M12 17h.01"/></svg>',
        info: '<svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 16v-4M12 8h.01"/></svg>'
    };

    var titles = {
        success: 'Success',
        danger: 'Error',
        warning: 'Warning',
        info: 'Info'
    };

    var messages = {
        success: 'Your changes were saved.',
        danger: 'The operation could not be completed.',
        warning: 'Your session will expire soon.',
        info: 'A new version is available.'
    };

    function create(type) {
        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = 'zak-toast zak-toast-' + type;
        toast.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        toast.innerHTML =
            '<span class="zak-toast-icon">' + icons[type] + '</span>' +
            '<div style="flex:1;"><div class="zak-toast-title">' + titles[type] + '</div>' +
            '<div class="zak-toast-text">' + messages[type] + '</div></div>' +
            '<button class="zak-toast-close" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>';
        toast.querySelector('.zak-toast-close').addEventListener('click', function() {
            toast.remove();
        });
        return toast;
    }

    function demo(type) {
        if (type === 'stack') {
            ['success', 'info', 'warning'].forEach(function(t, i) {
                setTimeout(function() { container.appendChild(create(t)); }, i * 350);
            });
            return;
        }
        container.appendChild(create(type));
    }

    return { demo: demo, create: create };
})();

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-toast                    /* Base toast */
.zak-toast-icon               /* Circular icon badge */
.zak-toast-title              /* Bold title */
.zak-toast-text               /* Muted body text */
.zak-toast-close              /* Close button */
.zak-toast-success            /* Success variant */
.zak-toast-danger             /* Danger variant */
.zak-toast-warning            /* Warning variant */
.zak-toast-info               /* Info variant */
.zak-toast-container          /* Fixed stacking container */
.zak-toast-container-top-start / -top-center / -top-end
.zak-toast-container-bottom-start / -bottom-center / -bottom-end
.zak-toast-enter / -enter-active  /* Enter animation classes */

Accessibility

  • Use role="status" for polite toasts and role="alert" for critical ones.
  • Do not use time as the only signal; also keep the toast dismissable by keyboard.
  • Ensure toast close buttons have a descriptive aria-label.
  • For auto-dismiss toasts, consider pausing dismiss while the user hovers or focuses the toast.
HTML
<div class="zak-toast zak-toast-danger" role="alert">
    <div class="zak-toast-title">Connection lost</div>
    <button class="zak-toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss notification">&times;</button>
</div>
